Idea 1 of 4

Every page should ask for one thing

Most sites ask visitors to do five things at once: call, book, subscribe, follow, read the blog. When a page asks for everything, people do nothing.

Try this in 5 minutes

1
Open your homepage.
2
Count every button and link that asks the visitor to act.
3
Pick the one action that matters most to your business.
4
Make that button the biggest and brightest. Quiet the rest.

This is Phase 7 of the framework (Conversion Mechanics). Do it before you change anything else. It costs nothing.

Hit reply and tell me which action you picked. I read every reply.
